technical.summary: Strong short-term bullish structure with golden crosses and price above key MAs, but extreme RSI(9) overbought condition and weak ADX trend strength limit swing entry probability; better suited for pullback entry or confirmation of momentum continuation.

fundamental.summary: CTRA shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 22 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear sentiment presents contrarian buy opportunity, supported by weak congressional buying signal from junior member 113 days prior; lack of recent news data limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress (inverted yield curve, VIX 344.6 crisis regime, rising DXY, imminent CPI event) creates severe headwinds; energy sector exposure and 22-day earnings window compound risk.
